fixes.explanation: Yes, friend, covenant. God says, “I will establish My covenant between Me and you…” A covenant is a binding promise, and this one comes straight from God Almighty. He adds, “…and I will multiply you exceedingly.” Abram is ninety-nine, and I bet he's thinking, "Multiply? I can't even multiply my knees getting off the ground!"

Prophets are a good guess, and I like the thinking. But God says, “I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.” Kings is the word He picks. Missing one word on a card happens to everybody, friend. I once pressed a whole batch upside down and called it modern art.

Baked just right, and what a timeline! God says Sarah will bear Isaac “…at this time next year.” Not someday. NEXT YEAR. Abraham is a hundred years old and he can circle the date on the calendar. I think he laughed because the math was wild, and I bet he still checked it twice.
